name: user_login
description: Verify your API key and receive an access token valid for one hour.

name: workspace_list
description: List the workspaces you own or that are shared with you.

name: workspace_details
description: Read one workspace: libraries, accounts, members, pending invites and account manager.

name: workspace_members
description: Members of a workspace with role and status, and the approvers you can send content to.

name: account_details
description: Who the API key belongs to: name, email, timezone, plan, default workspace and queue state.

name: connect_social_account_urls
description: Get the links that connect a new social account to a workspace.

name: social_account_list
description: List the social accounts of a workspace with their connection state.

name: library_list
description: Get every content library in a workspace with its id and name.

name: library_details
description: Read one library: name, colour, state, one-time-use flag, seasonal window and post counts.

name: library_create
description: Create a content library in the workspace.

name: library_content_list
description: Page through the active posts of one library.

name: library_content_search
description: Find active library posts whose text, link title, variation or network version contains a phrase.

name: library_content_delete
description: Delete one or more posts from a library.

name: add_content_in_library
description: Add a recurring post to a content library.

name: post_content
description: Publish a post now, or schedule it, on one or more social accounts.

name: post_status
description: Where a post stands on every account it was sent to.

name: media_upload_url
description: Get a signed URL to upload an image or video directly to RecurPost storage.

name: queue_list
description: Queued items of the workspace in a date window, one per account and time.

name: queue_post
description: One queued item by its id.

name: queue_post_update
description: Move a queued item to a new time, replace its content, or both.

name: queue_post_delete
description: Remove one or several queued items.

name: queue_reschedule
description: Move queued items to another day, keeping each item's time of day.

name: queue_post_now
description: Publish queued items of one post right away.

name: post_retry
description: Retry a failed queue item now or at a new time.

name: draft_list
description: List the drafts of a workspace with the accounts each one targets.

name: draft_save
description: Save a new draft, or replace the content and accounts of an existing one.

name: draft_schedule
description: Turn a draft into a scheduled post at the given time, keeping its id.

name: draft_delete
description: Delete a draft and every account row it holds.

name: approval_list
description: List library posts in the approval flow: waiting on you, sent by you, or rejected.

name: approval_approve
description: Approve a waiting library post into its library, or reject it with a message for the author. This tool runs the approve action.

name: approval_reject
description: Approve a waiting library post into its library, or reject it with a message for the author. This tool runs the reject action.

name: approval_comment
description: Add a comment to the thread of a rejected post.

name: history_data
description: Posting history of one social account, built for polling.

name: history_list
description: Published and failed posts across every account of the workspace, newest first.

name: history_to_library
description: Copy a published post into one or more libraries as evergreen content.

name: schedule_list
description: List every time slot of the workspace, optionally for one library or account.

name: report_account
description: Analytics for one social account, or the overview of every account in the workspace.

name: workflow_board
description: Columns and cards of the board, for one workspace or for every workspace of the owner you belong to.

name: generate_content_with_ai
description: Generate post text from a prompt, with multi-turn follow-ups to refine it.

name: generate_image_with_ai
description: Generate one image from a text description and get its URL.
